bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth: Mammals - Cold
bbcamerica.us.description: From ice covered seas to snow-capped mountains, mammals have conquered the cold, living in the most inhospitable places on Earth thanks to their intelligence and adaptations. (Nature, Documentary) - 2024-04-21

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth: Mammals - Water
bbcamerica.us.description: From freshwater jungle ponds to the dark depths of the open ocean, air breathing mammals have found ways to overcome the challenges of a life in water. (Nature, Documentary) - 2024-04-14

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth: Mammals - The New Wild
bbcamerica.us.description: Mammals have mastered every environment on Earth, but today the planet is changing rapidly, thanks to one mammal in particular; as humans reshape the planet, mammals must change with it and find surprising ways to survive this new wild. (Nature, Documentary) - 2024-04-07

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth: Mammals - Heat
bbcamerica.us.description: By pushing themselves and their bodies to the absolute limit, mammals like the camel, echidna, and vampire bat have found remarkable ways to beat the heat, surviving in some of the hottest places on Earth. (Nature, Documentary) - 2024-04-28

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth: Mammals - Dark
bbcamerica.us.description: With heightened senses verging on superpowers, over two thirds of mammal species are creatures of the night with some even returning to the dark side as their daytime world gets more and more crowded. (Nature, Documentary) - 2024-03-31

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth: Mammals - Forest
bbcamerica.us.description: David Attenborough reveals why forests are the ultimate test of survival for mammals and how they have overcome the challenges of life in this multidimensional, complex and continually changing environment. (Nature, Documentary) - 2024-05-05

bbcamerica.us.title: Rocky
bbcamerica.us.description: Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone), a small-time boxer from working-class Philadelphia, is arbitrarily chosen to take on the reigning world heavyweight champion, Apollo Creed (Carl Weathers), when the undefeated fighter's scheduled opponent is injured. While training with feisty former bantamweight contender Mickey Goldmill (Burgess Meredith), Rocky tentatively begins a relationship with Adrian (Talia Shire), the wallflower sister of his meat-packer pal Paulie (Burt Young). (Drama) - 1976

bbcamerica.us.title: Rocky II
bbcamerica.us.description: Although working-class Philadelphia boxer Rocky Balboa lost his high-profile bout with the cocky world champion Apollo Creed, his Cinderella story has caught the national sports media's attention, and he now has the opportunity to capitalize on his sudden fame. Meanwhile, Creed is still smarting from nearly losing to some palooka no one has ever heard of, and arrogantly prods his newfound nemesis into getting back into the ring. (Drama) - 1979

bbcearth.us.title: Big Bear Diary

bbcearth.us.title: Snow Wolf Family and Me - Big Bad Wolves

bbcearth.us.title: The Bear Family and Me - Summer

bbcfood.us.title: Hairy Bikers' Bakeation
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 France In Lyon, Dave and Si explore the 'bouchon', a restaurant normally run by a female chef.

bbcfood.us.title: Hairy Bikers' Bakeation
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 Spain Dave and Si journey through Spain and visit a traditional Basque dining club in San Sebastián.

bbcfood.us.title: The Hairy Bikers' Christmas Party
bbcfood.us.description: Si King and Dave Myers throw a Christmas party with finger foods including canapés, mini-desserts and spicy Thai treats, for family, friends and some of the people they have met on the road.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E01 Shellfish Chef Blanc celebrates the best of British shellfish as he cooks dishes including Moules Marinière, seared squid salad and Scottish lobster.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E02 Cakes and Pastries Chef Raymond begins with a feather-light lemon tea cake, coated in an apricot jam and tangy lemon glaze; he also makes a choux pastry filled with chocolate cream and covered with a chocolate icing; lastly, the secrets to the perfect macarons.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E03 Lamb Chef Blanc shares his favorite lamb dishes: lamb liver with caramelized potatoes and French seasoning, a slow-roasted garlic and herb lamb shoulder with potato and turnip gratin and lamb Provencal with ratatouille.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E04 Pudding Raymond celebrates his passion for puddings, cooking dishes including riz au lait, tarte tatin and fruit crumble.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E05 Charcuterie Chef Raymond shares his love of charcuterie, beginning with thin slices of duck cured in herbs and juniper berries; also, he makes a chicken liver parfait and a meaty pot-au-feu medley; lastly, a ham hock terrine served with home-made pickles.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E06 Spices and Chillies Drawing upon his travels through Asia, Raymond creates dishes full of fragrant spice and fiery heat.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E07 Summer Fruits Raymond demonstrates the versatility of the summer's juiciest fruits with a simple but impressive berry-strewn pavlova and a spicy cherry clafoutis where the vibrant fruit is cushioned in a bed of soft, sumptuous pastry.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E08 Summer Greens Raymond celebrates the freshest summer greens, beginning with a simple yet vibrant pistou soup, laden with summer vegetables and bursting with basil, topped with crispy croutons and meltingly rich Parmesan.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Nisha cooks some Malaysian mussels and ginger biscuit lamb raan.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Nisha cooks meatball curry and tandoori chops with turmeric chips.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 Nisha cooks egg and cauliflower curry and some Hungarian plum dumplings.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E09 Nisha cooks Bengali fish in banana leaves and a big roasted rib of beef.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E10 Nisha cooks chicken and apricot biryani and fish finger sandwiches.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 India and America A spicy shark vindaloo and the making of an authentic dhal with lentils.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Australia and Italy Seafood king Rick travels to Queensland, Australia.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 America and Cornwall Chesapeake Bay in the U.S., cooking traditional oyster dishes.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Thailand and Cornwall Rick goes to Hua Hin in Thailand, where he spends time in local markets talking to locals about various types of food; in Cornwall, he fries fish and jazzes it up with red curry and steamed jasmine rice.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 America and Yorkshire Rick visits America, Naples and the UK in Whitby, with good old English fish and chips in the final episode.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Sweet and Sour Nigel Slater shows us how to prepare five different sweet and sour dishes.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Fish and Meat Nigel continues to explore successful food marriages in the kitchen.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Spicy and Cool Nigel Slater shows us how to mix spicy flavors with something cooling.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Soft and Crisp Nigel Slater continues his exploration of brilliant culinary combinations.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Sugar and Spice Nigel shows a classic cinnamon, ginger and plum cake and demonstrates the unexpected such as sticky ribs and a spicy lentil stew with caramelized onions.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Born and Bred Nigel transforms everyday suppers, including a dish of baked mushrooms and chestnuts and a home-grown pud of blackberry and fig pie.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Kolkata and Chennai Rick explores Bengal and Tamil Nadu, the regions that began Britain's love affair with curry; Rick enjoys the prominence of fish and seafood in their dishes, flavored with mustard in Kolkata and tamarind in Chennai.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Mumbai and Pondicherry Rick explores Mumbai in search of the bombil, the fish that immortalized Bombay Duck; enjoying Parsee hospitality.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Lucknow and Punjab Rick Stein arrives in the cultural city of Lucknow, India; it is reputed to be the curry capital of India.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Rajasthan and Himachal Pradesh Rick Stein visits the royal state of Rajasthan, a land of kings, hilltop forts and palaces, where the local population are serious meat-eaters.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Madurai and Lucknow Rick Stein discovers a five-star hotel in Madurai employing local housewives for genuine home-cooked dishes and enjoys Chettinad Chicken, a dish inspired by spices brought back from both the east and the west by traveling merchants.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Nigella introduces her love of Italian food through a spectacular yet simple Sicilian pasta with tomatoes, garlic and almonds and a mid-week family feast of tagliata.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Nigella Lawson shares the secrets of her Italian roast chicken, served alongside a saffron orzotto; Nigella prepares coffee ice cream for dessert, inspired by the ice cream parlors of Florence; a chocolate olive oil cake provides an extra treat.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Episode 3 Pork loin stuffed with Parma ham and oregano, served alongside her speedy mock mash and lazy person's vignarola.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Liquorice pudding; Sardinian sun-dried and toasted couscous; butterflied leg of lamb; baby aubergines with oregano and roasted red onion.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Nigella starts with her take on a light and sunny yogurt pot cake; she recruits her niece and nephew to make a shortcut sausage meatball supper; Nigella prepares squid and prawns with marjoram and chili; a tiramisu ends the evening.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Episode 6 Lamb chops with mint; chilli and golden potatoes; ruby red plum and amoretti crumble; farro risotto with mushrooms.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Rick Stein searches for herring along the northeast coast of Scotland.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Pilchards, bream, ormer and cockles with laverbread.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Sweet brown shrimp; flounder; fresh salmon; oysters; scallops.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Silver eels; edible seaweed; langoustines; pollan.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Cockles and samphire; pink shrimps; Cromer crabs.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Wild smoked salmon; sea trout; sea moss pudding.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 Fresh cod; smoked kippers; prepares halibut with cucumber; salmon en croute.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Cambodia and Vietnam Rick enjoys freshly caught swimmer crabs cooked with green peppercorns.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Vietnam and Thailand Rick Stein travels down the Mekong River to Vietnam.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Thailand and Malaysia Rick travels to Phuket to learn the art of hot and sour tom yum goong.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Malaysia and Sri Lanka Rick explores the multi-faceted cuisines of Penang; in Sri Lanka, he continues his passion for seafood by visiting a bustling fishing village.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Sri Lanka and Bali Rick visits Sri Lanka and discovers a wealth of hot and spicy vegetable curries.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Bangladesh Curry is at the top of Rick's list as he ends his culinary tour in Bangladesh.

bouncetv.us.title: The Nutty Professor
bouncetv.us.description: Brilliant and obese scientist Sherman Klump (Eddie Murphy) invents a miraculous weight-loss solution. After a date with chemistry student Carla Purty (Jada Pinkett) goes badly, a depressed Klump tries the solution on himself. Though he instantly loses 250 pounds, the side effects include a second personality: an obnoxiously self-assertive braggart who calls himself Buddy Love. Buddy proves to be more popular than Sherman, but his arrogance and bad behavior quickly spiral out of control. (Comedy) - 1996

bouncetv.us.title: Nutty Professor II: The Klumps
bouncetv.us.description: Professor Sherman Klump (Eddie Murphy) is getting married. And the Klump family could not be more delighted. His fiancée Denise (Janet Jackson) is thrilled to become a Klump, and with her appetite she'll fit right in. But Buddy Love ... well, Buddy is another matter. (Comedy) - 2000

buzzr.us.description: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800. (Game show) - 1978-04-24

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

cinevault.us.title: Close Encounters of the Third Kind: The Director's Cut
cinevault.us.description: Science fiction adventure about a group of people who attempt to contact alien intelligence. Roy Neary (Richard Dreyfuss) witnesses an unidentified flying object, and even has a "sunburn" from its bright lights to prove it. Roy refuses to accept an explanation for what he saw and is prepared to give up his life to pursue the truth about UFOs. (Movie, Science fiction) - 1977

cinevault.us.title: Battle: Los Angeles
cinevault.us.description: For many years, humans have reported various UFO sightings around the world, fueling speculation about the existence of life on other worlds. In 2011, mankind learns the truth the hard way when alien invaders attack. One by one, the world's great cities fall, leaving Los Angeles as the battleground for humanity's last stand. It's up to a Marine staff sergeant (Aaron Eckhart) and his platoon to draw a line in the sand against a powerful enemy unlike any previously encountered. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science fiction) - 2011-03-10

cinevault.us.title: Blue Thunder
cinevault.us.description: Frank Murphy is a courageous and honorable Los Angeles police officer who is chosen to test run Blue Thunder, a high-tech experimental attack helicopter. While flying Blue Thunder, Murphy and his partner discover that the government intends to use the helicopter for corrupt crowd control and surveillance. (Action, Drama, Movie) - 1983-05-13

cinevault.us.title: Conspiracy
cinevault.us.description: A former Marine (Val Kilmer) brings justice to a small town after his friend mysteriously disappears. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 2008-02-15

cinevault.us.title: Straw Dogs
cinevault.us.description: Married couple David (James Marsden) and Amy (Kate Bosworth) move to her hometown of Blackwater, Miss., after her father's death. They have a plan to renovate Amy's old home and prepare it for sale while David works on his latest screenplay. However, the sophisticated couple's arrival stirs resentment and suspicion among the locals, especially from Charlie (Alexander Skarsgård), Amy's former boyfriend. Tension continues to build, leading to an extremely violent confrontation. (Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2011-09-16

cinevault.us.title: Suspect
cinevault.us.description: Carl Anderson (Liam Neeson), a deaf, mute and homeless war veteran, is arrested for the murder of a prominent judge's secretary. But Kathleen Riley (Cher), Anderson's lawyer, believes her client is innocent. She sets out to track down the real killer, and, as the trial proceeds, makes an unlikely ally in Eddie Sanger (Dennis Quaid), a jury member. When they aren't in court, the two investigate the case and manage to uncover a massive conspiracy. (Movie, Thriller) - 1987-10-23

cinevault.us.title: Agnes of God
cinevault.us.description: Dr. Martha Livingston (Jane Fonda) is a court-appointed psychiatrist sent to evaluate Sister Agnes (Meg Tilly), a young nun whose infant has been found strangled. With Agnes claiming a virgin conception and having no memory of giving birth, Livingston must distinguish between the lies and the nun's perception-altering faith. Complicating her investigation, Livingston continually clashes with the overbearing Mother Miriam Ruth (Anne Bancroft), who insists that Livingston leave Agnes alone. (Drama, Movie) - 1985-09-13

cinevault.us.title: Raising Waylon
cinevault.us.description: A restaurateur (Thomas Gibson) and a photographer (Poppy Montgomery) learn surprising things about themselves while taking care of their 9-year-old godchild. (Movie, Romantic comedy) - 2004-02-22

cinevault.us.title: 3 Ninjas Kick Back
cinevault.us.description: Young martial artists face their grandfather's foes when they accompany him to Japan to deliver a priceless dagger. (Children, Comedy, Movie) - 1994-05-06

cinevault.us.title: North
cinevault.us.description: North (Elijah Wood) is a talented and bright kid, but his mom (Julia Louis-Dreyfus) and dad (Jason Alexander) are utterly preoccupied with other things in their lives, leaving him largely ignored. Advised by a mysterious man (Bruce Willis) who pops up on occasion, North decides to legally separate himself from his parents and goes on a search across the globe for the ideal mother and father. Unfortunately for the young boy, most of the people that he meets have very little potential. (Children, Comedy drama, Movie) - 1994-07-22

cinevault.us.title: Lost & Found
cinevault.us.description: Sent to spend the summer with their uncle on a remote island, young brothers, Andy (Justin Kelly) and Mark (Benjamin Stockham), learn that their eccentric grandfather once owned the island but vanished without a trace, taking with him the secret to a vast fortune. Delving into the mysterious past of the island, the brothers discover that their grandfather designed a complex treasure hunt, a hunt that could lead to unimaginable wealth and heal their broken family. (Adventure, Drama, Movie, Mystery) - 2016-02-22

cinevault.us.title: Open Season
cinevault.us.description: Boog (Martin Lawrence), a 900-pound grizzly bear, is content entertaining tourists and living in park ranger Beth's (Debra Messing) barn. His life takes a drastic turn when he rescues a one-horned mule deer named Elliot (Ashton Kutcher) from a hunter (Gary Sinise), and is subsequently tranquilized and returned to the wild. Elliot and Boog recruit the other animals, notably a Scottish squirrel (Billy Connolly) and a beaver foreman, to help turn the tables on the hunters to make the woods safe. (Adventure, Animated, Children, Comedy, Movie) - 2006-09-29

cinevault.us.title: The Buddy Holly Story
cinevault.us.description: A chronicle of the rise and brief career of rock 'n' roll star Buddy Holly (Gary Busey), who aspires to play music the way he wants it to sound. Holly and his band, the Crickets, are first invited to record in Nashville, where they encounter creative differences with the producing staff. Later they play a major booking at the Apollo Theater, scheduled there under the mistaken assumption that they're a black band. Holly's career eventually goes solo -- until the tragic day the music dies. (Biography, Movie, Music, Rock) - 1978-05-18

cinevault.us.title: The Mask of Zorro
cinevault.us.description: After being imprisoned for 20 years, Zorro -- Don Diego de la Vega (Anthony Hopkins) -- receives word that his old enemy, Don Rafael Montero (Stuart Wilson), has returned. Don Diego escapes and returns to his old headquarters, where he trains aimless drunk Alejandro Murrieta (Antonio Banderas) to be his successor. Meanwhile, Montero -- who has secretly raised Diego's daughter, Elena (Catherine Zeta-Jones), as his own -- hatches a plot to rob California of its gold. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Movie) - 1998-07-17

cinevault.us.title: The Legend of Zorro
cinevault.us.description: A secret society, the Knights of Aragon, seeks to keep the United States from achieving manifest destiny -- and only the legendary Zorro (Antonio Banderas) can stop them. Unfortunately, Zorro, also known as Don Alejandro de la Vega, has problems of his own: His wife, Elena (Catherine Zeta-Jones), is divorcing him for spending too much time pursuing heroics and not enough being a father to their young son. But it isn't long before the whole family gets caught up in stopping the Knights. (Action, Adventure, Movie) - 2005-10-28

cinevault.us.title: Brian's Song
cinevault.us.description: Although they both play for the Chicago Bears, Brian Piccolo (Sean Maher) is white, a joker and mostly rides the bench while Gale Sayers (Mekhi Phifer) is black, serious and a rookie superstar. Neither likes the other much, but when coach Halas (Ben Gazzara) makes them the first interracial roommates in the NFL, the two gradually form a sincere friendship. Piccolo helps Sayers overcome an injury, and Sayers later gives Piccolo much needed support when he's diagnosed with terminal cancer. (Docudrama, Movie) - 2001-12-02

cinevault.us.title: Crossroads

cinevault.us.title: The Baby-Sitters Club

When a group of adults led by their crotchety neighbor, Emily Haberman, tries to shut down the camp, the girls must band together to keep their dream alive. Meanwhile, each club member faces her own personal challenges, including divorced parents, a discouraging diabetes diagnosis and an innocent crush on an older boy. (Children, Drama, Movie) - 1995-08-18

cinevault.us.title: Annie

While Annie gets accustomed to living in Warbucks' mansion, she still longs to meet her parents. So Warbucks announces a search for them and a reward, which brings out many frauds. After his father (Tom Wilkinson) dies, Britt meets Kato (Jay Chou), a resourceful company employee. Realizing that they have the talent and resources to make something of their lives, Britt and Kato join forces as costumed crime-fighters to bring down the city's most-powerful criminal, Chudnofsky (Christoph Waltz). filmriseaction.us.title: Castle Falls
filmriseaction.us.description: After decades of neglect, Castle Heights Hospital is packed with dynamite and ready to be demolished. However, no one knows that a gang leader, now in prison, hid $3 million in stolen cash inside the abandoned building. Now, three desperate parties want the money -- and they have exactly 90 minutes to find it and get out alive. (Action, Thriller) - 2021

filmriseaction.us.title: Mercenary for Justice
filmriseaction.us.description: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag. (Family, Action, Thriller) - 2006

filmriseaction.us.title: Arlington Road
filmriseaction.us.description: Widowed when his FBI agent wife is killed by an extremist group, college professor Michael Faraday (Jeff Bridges) becomes obsessed with the culture of these groups -- especially when his new all-American neighbors, Oliver (Tim Robbins) and Cheryl Lang (Joan Cusack), start acting suspiciously. With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road. (Thriller, Crime drama, Action, Mystery, Adventure) - 1999

filmriseaction.us.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
filmriseaction.us.description: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men. (Thriller, Historical drama, War) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: Freejack
filmriseaction.us.description: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place. (Science fiction) - 1992

filmriseaction.us.title: The Contract
filmriseaction.us.description: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire. (Thriller) - 2006

filmriseaction.us.title: Assault on Precinct 13
filmriseaction.us.description: When the LAPD kills several members of the South Central gang Street Thunder, the remaining members avenge themselves by way of a bloody war waged against cops and citizens alike. filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Going All the Way

retroplex.us.title: The Promise
retroplex.us.description: Brilliant medical student Michael (Oscar Isaac) meets beautiful dance instructor Ana (Charlotte Le Bon) in late 1914. Their shared Armenian heritage sparks an attraction that explodes into a romantic rivalry between Michael and Ana's boyfriend (Christian Bale), an American photojournalist who's dedicated to exposing the truth. As the Ottoman Empire crumbles into war-torn chaos, their conflicting passions must be deferred as they join forces to get themselves and their people to safety. (Historical drama, Romance) - 2016

retroplex.us.title: Outride the Devil: A Morning With Doc Holliday
retroplex.us.description: Kit Hussey presents the highlights from the last fourteen years of Doc Holliday's life, which ended in a gunfight. (Special, Performing arts) - 2007-01-30

retroplex.us.title: The Star Packer
retroplex.us.description: Loner U.S. Marshal John Travers (John Wayne) foils the hold-up of a stagecoach, rescuing young woman Anita Matlock (Verna Hillie) from the clutches of the crooks and helping her back to town. But there, the sheriff is gunned down by bandits, so Travers starts investigating and connects the murder to a gang, led by an unidentified bandit known as the Shadow, who's been running the town ragged for some time. Travers then makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down the Shadow. (Western) - 1934

retroplex.us.title: Colorado Serenade
retroplex.us.description: One night, while out riding his horse, Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) comes upon a stagecoach being robbed by bandits. He intervenes and rescues the passengers, including a newly appointed judge, Roy Hilton (Forrest Taylor), who's traveling to the nearby town of Rawhide to bring law and order to the community. After witnessing Dean's heroics, the judge enlists the cowboy to help him, but their efforts are complicated by the arrival of mysterious drifter Nevada (David Sharpe). (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Tumbleweed Trail
retroplex.us.description: Scheming to steal Bill Ryan's (Kermit Maynard) cattle to pay a debt, his half-brother, Brad Barton (Bob Duncan), has his men shoot the rancher. With Bill left for dead, Brad and corrupt lawyer Alton Small (Ted Adams) produce a forged will that disinherits Bill's teenage daughter, Robin (Shirley Patterson), and son Freckles (Johnny McGovern). Aid arrives in the form of cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), who help Robin fight for her rightful property. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: West to Glory
retroplex.us.description: Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), an undercover U.S. agent, is sent to a Mexican border town to protect the valuable Lopez diamond. One day he and his friend Soapy (Roscoe Ates) attend a party thrown by Don Lopez (Harry Vejar), a wealthy prospector who also holds large reserves of gold. After Lopez insists that the mysterious Maria (Dolores Castle) wear the precious gem, Eddie becomes suspicious that she may be in league with the gang that recently stole some of Lopez's gold and killed one of his men. (Western) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: Wild Country
retroplex.us.description: Bandit Rip Caxton (I. Stanford Jolley) escapes from prison, and U.S. Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) track him to a small town. There, Caxton kills a sheriff, and, with the help of crooked local saloon boss Clark Varney (Douglas Fowley), installs a conspirator in the dead lawman's place. Meanwhile, Eddie comes across Martha Devery (Peggy Wynn), the distressed daughter of the former sheriff, and promises her he will bring the villains to justice. (Western) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: Black Hills
retroplex.us.description: When their father is shot by Dan Kirby (Terry Frost) after discovering a gold mine on his ranch, Larry Hadley (Steve Drake) and his sister, Janet (Shirley Patterson), ask foreman Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) for help in retaining their land. Eddie's arrival with sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) disrupts Dan's plans to take over the property. Desperate to obtain the ranch, Dan blackmails accountant Tuttle (Bill Fawcett) into forging a document that will help him take control. (Western) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: Bells of Coronado
retroplex.us.description: An insurance agent investigating a mine owner's death is pitted against foreign agents and uranium smugglers. (Western) - 1950

retroplex.us.title: The Lucky Texan
retroplex.us.description: Jerry Mason (John Wayne), fresh out of college back East, heads home to Texas to join a blacksmith business with family friend Jake (George Hayes). But when they discover a gold nugget in a horseshoe, they're led down a dangerous path, as crooks Joe Cole (Yakima Canutt) and Harris (Lloyd Whitlock) scheme to take the rock from the unsuspecting Jerry and Jake. This ultimately gets Jake shot and wounded, lands Jerry in jail unjustly and leaves the pair plotting to get revenge on the criminals. (Western) - 1934

retroplex.us.title: In Old Amarillo
retroplex.us.description: A villainous cannery owner tries to foil efforts to get water to cattle ranchers during a severe drought. (Western) - 1951

retroplex.us.title: Down Missouri Way
retroplex.us.description: In this musical, agriculture professor Jane Colwell (Martha O'Driscoll) is seeking a quiet getaway when she takes her prized mule off to visit an Ozarks farming community. But upon arrival she is stunned to discover a film crew diligently at work on a new movie. Soon, Jane and her mule companion are swept up in the filmmaking frenzy. While the photogenic mule upstages the production's human star (Renee Godfrey), Jane finds herself falling for the feature's dashing producer (William Wright). (Musical comedy) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Jericho
retroplex.us.description: Jericho (Mark Valley) wakes up with no memory, but it's apparent that he's quite skilled with a gun. He is befriended by Joshua (Leon Coffee), who appears to be his polar opposite: He's a black man and true believer in the Lord, whereas Jericho is white and doubtful of everything, especially himself. Side by side, they attempt to piece together the amnesiac's past, which may or may not have something to do with a robbery, and either way is somehow connected to a town that's also called Jericho. classica.us.title: Dvořák - Rusalka
classica.us.description: Der bulgarische Dirigent Pavel Baleff dirigiert das Orchester und den Chor der Opéra de Limoges in einer Aufführung von Antonín Dvořáks Rusalka. Das Libretto des Werkes stammt von dem tschechischen Dichter Jaroslav Kvapil. (Special, Music) - 2025-08-31

classica.us.title: Schumann - 2. Klaviersonate in g-Moll, op. 22
classica.us.description: In dieser Aufführung präsentiert Riccardo Schwartz Schumanns Klaviersonate Nr. 2 in g-Moll, Op. 22. Es beginnt mit einem energischen ersten Satz, gefolgt von einem wunderschönen, langsamen Andantino nach Schumanns Lied "Im Herbste". (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2024-01-09

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Diabelli Variationen, Op. 120
classica.us.description: Daniel Barenboim spielt Beethovens letztes großes Klavierwerk, fertiggestellt im Jahre 1823. (Music) - 2020-05-05

classica.us.title: Werke für Violine und Klavier: Corelli, Ravel u.a
classica.us.description: Der japanische Geiger Naoya Nishimura und der italienische Pianist Andrea Bacchetti präsentieren ein intimes Recital, das in der Munetsugu Hall in Nagoya, Japan, aufgenommen wurde. Diese Aufführung wurde am 22. Juni 2019 aufgenommen. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2025-01-01

classica.us.title: Liszt - Elegien Nr. 1 und 2 (S. 130 & 131)
classica.us.description: Die italienische Cellistin Silvia Chiesa und der italienische Pianist Maurizio Baglini spielen Franz Liszts Zwei Elegien für Cello und Klavier. Diese Aufführung wurde am 4. November 2024 im Sala Verdi des Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi aufgenommen. (Special, Music) - 2025-10-04

classica.us.title: Die drei Leben der Clara Schumann
classica.us.description: Die Biografie von Clara Schumann ist legendenumwoben: Ihre strenge Kindheit, ihr außergewöhnliches Talent als Pianistin, ihre frühe Liebe zum Komponisten Robert Schumann und die Erziehung von sieben Kindern bieten Material für Mythen und Klischees. (Special, Documentary) - 2019-09-15

classica.us.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise für zwei Klaviere Op. 77
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags spielt Martha Argerich Saint-Saëns Polonaise für Klavier Op. 77. Das Konzert wurde im Château de Chantilly, Frankreich, aufgezeichnet. Die Pianistin wird von verschiedenen renommierten Künstlern begleitet. (Special, Music) - 2025-06-01

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: Clara Haskil - Das Geheimnis der Interpretin
classica.us.description: Für Freunde und Musiker war und ist die Schweizer Klaviervirtuosin Clara Haskil eine Interpretin, die wie keine andere Maßstäbe gesetzt hat. Anhand von Klaviereinspielungen, Briefen und Interviews zeigt der Film die Musikerin in neuem Licht. (Special, Documentary, Biography, Art) - 2017-08-27

classica.us.title: Rachmaninow - Sonate für Cello, Op. 19
classica.us.description: Silvia Chiesa und Maurizio Baglini präsentieren ein bezauberndes Konzert mit Werken von Busoni, Liszt, Chopin und Rachmaninow. Diese Aufführung wurde am 4. November 2024 im Sala Verdi des Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Mailand aufgenommen. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2025-10-04

classica.us.title: Heyward dirigiert Dvořáks Sinfonie Nr. 9
classica.us.description: Es ist eins der beliebtesten Stücke aller Zeiten: Mit der Aufführung von der 9. Sinfonie e-Moll unter dem Namen "Aus der Neuen Welt" von Antonín Dvořáks gibt der amerikanische Dirigent Jonathon Heyward mit dem "London Symphony Orchestra" sein Debüt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-10-04

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Streichquartette Nr. 3, 8 & 11
classica.us.description: Das französische Streichquartett Quatuor Ébène feiert den 250. Geburtstag von Ludwig van Beethoven mit der Aufnahme aller sechzehn Streichquartette des Komponisten, aufgeführt in sechs Konzerten in der Philharmonie de Paris im Herbst 2020. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2024-09-07

classica.us.title: Grieg, Klavierkonzert, Op. 16
classica.us.description: Artur Rubinstein und das London Symphony Orchestra unter der Leitung von André Previn spielen das Klavierkonzert a-Moll op. 16 von Edvard Grieg (1843-1907). Diese Aufnahme entstand im April 1975 in der Fairfield Hall Croydon. Auch im Alter von 88 Jahren schien Artur Rubinstein (1887-1982) nichts von der Lebenslust verloren zu haben, mit der er sein Publikum bereits seit fast einem Dreivierteljahrhundert begeistert hatte. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2012-12-17

classica.us.title: Bach - Matthäus-Passion, BWV 244
classica.us.description: Sie gilt als fester Bestandteil des österlichen Musikrepertoires - Bachs Matthäus-Passion. 2014 führt das portugiesische Gulbenkian Orchester das Werk unter der Leitung von Michel Corboz im Grande Auditório in Lissabon auf. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2020-04-10

classica.us.title: Mahler - Kindertotenlieder
classica.us.description: Mahlers Kindertotenlieder ist ein zutiefst persönlicher Liederzyklus für Gesang und Orchester, inspiriert von Friedrich Rückerts Gedichten über den Verlust seiner Kinder. (Special) - 2026-03-07

classica.us.title: Schönheit ist ein Verbrechen: Mendelssohn & Brahms
classica.us.description: Teodor Currentzis dirigiert sein Musikensemble MusicAeterna und die Violinspielerin Patricia Kopatchinskaja in einem Konzertprogramm. Thema ist die Suche nach einer neuen Definition von Schönheit. Brahms und Mendelssohn werden in neues Licht gerückt. (Special, Music, Concert) - 2020-04-01

classica.us.title: Strawinsky - Psalmensinfonie
classica.us.description: Fabio Luisi steht zum ersten Mal als Dirigent des Dänischen Radio-Sinfonieorchesters im DR Koncerthuset auf der Bühne. Zu diesem Anlass leitet der Italiener seine Musiker unter anderem durch Igor Strawinskis bewegende Psalmensinfonie. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2020-07-29

classica.us.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Halbfinale I: Anthony Ratinov
classica.us.description: Der Pianist Anthony Ratinov spielt im zweiten Halbfinale des Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 den ersten Satz des Klavierquartetts, op. 47 von Robert Schumann. Er wird von den Hauptstreichern des Montreal Symphonieorchesters begleitet. (Event, Music, Classical) - 2025-02-25

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Sinfonie Nr. 5 in c-Moll, op. 67
classica.us.description: In der Oper von Dijon, wo das Ensemble residiert, interpretieren die Mitglieder von Les Dissonances die Symphonie Nr. 5 in C-Dur, Opus 67, von Ludwig van Beethoven. Die Originalität dieser Sinfonie liegt im anfänglichen Vier-Noten-Motiv. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2015-08-24

classica.us.title: Mozart - Requiem in d-Moll, K. 626
classica.us.description: Daniel Harding dirigiert das Orchester und den Chor des Maggio Musicale Fiorentino sowie vier Gesangssolisten in einer prächtigen Aufführung von Wolfgang Amadeus Mozarts Requiem in d-Moll, K. 626. Die Solisten sind die Sopranistin Christiane Karg, die Mezzosopranistin Sara Mingardo, der Tenor Matthew Swensen und der Bass Gianluca Buratto. (Special, Music, Classical, Event) - 2024-11-03

classica.us.title: Wer hat das Boléro von Maurice Ravel gestohlen?
classica.us.description: In der Dokumentation wird der Rechtsstreit um das Musikstück Boléro untersucht. Das Stück wird von Maurice Ravel im Jahr 1928 komponiert und dieser gibt die Rechte an seinen Bruder Edouard. Dieser stirbt 1960 und löst den Rechtsstreit aus. (Special, Documentary) - 2016-05-01

classica.us.title: Eine Hommage an Wien
classica.us.description: Am 9. März 2011 zollten die Wiener Philharmoniker ihrer Heimatstadt mit einem Walzer-Konzert Tribut. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2021-08-20

outlaw.us.title: Chisum
outlaw.us.description: Kind-hearted, fatherly John Chisum (John Wayne) owns a large ranch in Lincoln County, New Mexico, in the 1870s. With the help of his faithful sidekick, Pepper (Ben Johnson), and a hot-headed young ranch hand nicknamed Billy the Kid (Geoffrey Deuel), Chisum does battle with underhanded land developer Lawrence Murphy (Forrest Tucker). Having bought up most of the nearby town and appointed his own corrupt sheriff (Bruce Cabot), Murphy now has his eye on Chisum's ranch. (Western) - 1970

outlaw.us.title: The Big Land
outlaw.us.description: Civil War veteran Chad Morgan (Alan Ladd) and alcoholic ex-architect Joe Jagger (Edmond O'Brien) are taken in by kindly Kansas farmer Sven (John Qualen) and his widowed daughter-in-law, Kate (Julie Bishop). To repay their kindness, Chad and Joe concoct a plan to create a market town for cattle and grain, with the help of Joe's sister, Helen (Virginia Mayo), and her railroad executive fiancé (Don Castle). But the violent boss of a nearby market (Anthony Caruso) will kill to keep his monopoly. (Western) - 1957

outlaw.us.title: The Command
outlaw.us.description: After Capt. Forsythe (Gregg Barton), the commanding officer of a cavalry troop, is killed in an attack, the new leader is Capt. Robert MacClaw (Guy Madison), a military doctor who has practically no field experience. With assistance from Sgt. Elliott (James Whitmore), MacClaw tries to lead his men to safety, using his ingenuity. But then they are ordered to guide a wagon train, containing the lovely Martha Cutting (Joan Weldon), among others, through dangerous American Indian territory. (Western) - 1954

outlaw.us.title: Bonanza - Blood on the Land
outlaw.us.description: Jeb Drummond is a murderous sheep herder who has Adam taken hostage to try and force Ben to sign over a large section of Ponderosa land to him. (Drama, Western) - 1960-02-13

outlaw.us.title: Hell on the Border
outlaw.us.description: A former slave becomes the first black deputy U.S. Marshal west of the Mississippi River in the late 1800s. (Western) - 2019

outlaw.us.title: Wild Stallion
outlaw.us.description: Raised by a cowboy (Edgar Buchanan) at a cavalry fort, an orphan becomes an officer (Ben Johnson) and looks for his long-lost horse. (Western) - 1952

outlaw.us.title: The Badlanders
outlaw.us.description: Peter Van Hoek emerges from jail with a plan to rob a gold mine and take revenge on the mine owner, the townspeople and the corrupt deputy who framed him for theft. Teaming up with John McBain, who owned the mine before being cheated out of it, Peter returns to the Arizona town where he was arrested. After meeting with mine owner Cyril, he assembles a team to steal gold from Cyril's mine and then sell it back to him. (Western) - 1958

outlaw.us.title: She Wore a Yellow Ribbon
outlaw.us.description: The last job of Calvary Captain Nathan Brittles (John Wayne) before retirement is to soothe relations with the Cheyenne and Arapaho Indians after Custer's last stand. At the same time, he must transport the wife (Mildred Natwick) and niece (Joanne Dru) of his commanding officer to a safe destination. After both his missions stall, Brittles attempts a face-to-face meeting with an important Native American chief in order to stave off an impending war. (Western, Adventure) - 1949

outlaw.us.title: Montana
outlaw.us.description: Aussie shepherd Morgan Lane (Errol Flynn) moves all the way to Montana in hopes of finding the perfect terrain for raising his sheep, but the local ranchers aren't keen on sharing their land with outsiders. Before long, Morgan clashes with powerful cattleman Rodney Ackroyd, and their rivalry is only intensified when Ackroyd's fiancée, Maria (Alexis Smith), has eyes for Morgan. However, her sympathies still lie with her lover, and it seems that only a gunfight can settle the conflict. (Western) - 1950

outlaw.us.title: The Old Way
outlaw.us.description: Retired gunslinger Colton Briggs faces the consequences of his past when the son of a man he murdered arrives to take his revenge. Briggs must take up arms once more after his wife is killed, and is joined by his young daughter. (Western, Action) - 2023

outtvproud.us.title: Ginger Snaps
outtvproud.us.description: The story of two outcast sisters, Ginger (Katharine Isabelle) and Brigitte (Emily Perkins), in the mindless suburban town of Bailey Downs. On the night of Ginger's first period, she is savagely attacked by a wild creature. Ginger's wounds miraculously heal, but something is not quite right. Now Brigitte must save her sister and save herself. (Horror, Thriller) - 2000

outtvproud.us.title: Ginger Snaps II: Unleashed
outtvproud.us.description: A patient (Tatiana Maslany) at a rehabilitation center tries to prevent a young woman (Emily Perkins) from transforming into a werewolf. (Horror) - 2004

outtvproud.us.title: Ginger Snaps Back: The Beginning
outtvproud.us.description: In early 19th-century Canada, orphaned sisters Ginger (Katharine Isabelle) and Brigitte (Emily Perkins) find themselves lost in a forest while riding on horseback. They're rescued by The Hunter (Nathaniel Arcand), a mysterious Native American who takes them back to Fort Bailey. Something strange has happened there, however. The few settlers who remain are suspicious of outsiders and keep tight-lipped about the situation, but Ginger soon discovers their secret for herself. (Horror, Thriller) - 2004

outtvproud.us.title: Cyborg 2: Glass Shadow
outtvproud.us.description: A cyborg designed to appear convincingly human, Casella "Cash" Reese (Angelina Jolie) is a spy and assassin for the massive Pinwheel Corporation. Set to ultimately self-destruct, Cash attempts to evade her fate with the aid of martial-arts expert and trainer Colson "Colt" Ricks (Elias Koteas) and a rebellious fellow cyborg named Mercy (Jack Palance). Naturally, the company doesn't want to lose one of their prize assets, so the ruthless Daniel Bench (Billy Drago) is sent to track Cash down. (Science fiction, Action, Thriller) - 1993

outtvproud.us.title: Repo! The Genetic Opera
outtvproud.us.description: In the mid-21st century, an epidemic of organ failures leads to the rise of GeneCo., a company providing transplants at a great price. Those who miss their payments become targets of GeneCo. Mercenaries, who repossess the organs. In a world of drug addiction and legalized murder, a sheltered youth seeks a cure for her rare disease as well as information about her family's mysterious history. Her questions are answered at "The Genetic Opera." (Horror, Musical) - 2008

outtvproud.us.title: From Prada to Nada
outtvproud.us.description: Spoiled sisters Nora (Camilla Belle) and Mary (Alexa Vega) Dominguez have a life of wealth and privilege in Beverly Hills. However, their world crashes when their father dies suddenly. Now penniless, the two have to move in with their Aunt Aurelia (Adriana Barraza) in East L.A.'s Boyle Heights. Striving to work through the culture clash, Nora and Mary begin to embrace their Latin heritage, discover romance, and learn the meaning of family. (Comedy, Romantic comedy, Action, Drama) - 2011

outtvproud.us.title: Lars and the Real Girl
outtvproud.us.description: Extremely shy Lars (Ryan Gosling) finds it impossible to make friends or socialize. His brother (Paul Schneider) and sister-in-law (Emily Mortimer) worry about him, so when he announces that he has a girlfriend he met on the Internet, they are overjoyed. But Lars' new lady is a life-size plastic woman. On the advice of a doctor (Patricia Clarkson), his family and the rest of the community go along with his delusion. (Comedy drama, Romance) - 2007

outtvproud.us.title: Mannequin Two: On the Move
outtvproud.us.description: Although Jason (William Ragsdale) works as a department store clerk, he is also a reincarnated prince. Long ago, his beloved Jessie (Kristy Swanson) was snatched away from him by an evil wizard (Terry Kiser) who used his powers to transform her into wooden statue. Now Jessie is in Jason's department store as a mannequin. When he encounters her, she awakens from her thousand-year sleep. They quickly revive their romance, but the evil wizard has been reincarnated as well, and he's up to no good. (Fantasy, Comedy, Romance) - 1991

outtvproud.us.title: Cadillac Man
outtvproud.us.description: Car dealer Joey O'Brien (Robin Williams) is spread as thin financially as he is in his love life. He's dating more women than he can remember, and the local toughs he's borrowed money from want it back. In a last-ditch effort to get out of debt, Joey struggles to sell a dozen cars in two days -- a task that becomes difficult when the husband (Tim Robbins) of Joey's secretary (Annabella Sciorra) barges into the dealership with a semi-automatic weapon and takes everyone hostage. (Comedy) - 1990

outtvproud.us.title: Cruel Intentions
outtvproud.us.description: Annette (Reese Witherspoon) unwittingly becomes a pawn in Sebastian's (Ryan Phillippe) and Kathryn's (Sarah Michelle Gellar) deliciously diabolical wager of sexual conquest when she writes an article in Seventeen Magazine about how she intends to stay pure until she marries her boyfriend. However, Sebastian gets more than he bargained for as he attempts to woo Annette into his bed. (Drama) - 1999

outtvproud.us.title: Frankenstein
outtvproud.us.description: In this re-imagining of Mary Shelley's classic, Dr. Frankenstein is Dr. Victor Helios (Thomas Kretschmann), who has found the means to prolong his life into the present. Portrayed as the villain, Helios has amassed a collection of monsters that are killing people in New Orleans. Detectives Carson O'Connor (Parker Posey) and Michael Sloane (Adam Goldberg) team with the doctor's first creation, Deucalion (Vincent Perez), to track down and stop the crazed evil scientist. outtvproud.us.title: Cyborg 2: Glass Shadow

shadesofblack.us.title: Blue Hill Avenue
shadesofblack.us.description: Four friends enter the drug trade in Boston in the late 1970s: Tristan (Allen Payne), Money (Aaron D. Spears), E-Bone and Simon. With the consent of a South End crime boss, Benny (Clarence Williams III), they quickly rise in the drug game, while the leader of the group, Tristan, keeps his double life a secret from his clueless parents. However, as the 1970s pass to the 2000s, a police investigation threatens to ignite a violent feud among the tight-knit friends. (Crime drama) - 2001

shadesofblack.us.title: Chaos

It transpires that a master thief has planted a computer virus that will drain funds from the bank's accounts. The detective faces a race against time to catch the thief and stop the randomly evolving computer virus, which models its behavior on the bewildering principles of chaos theory. shadesofblack.us.title: Soldier Boyz
shadesofblack.us.description: Veteran Howard Toliver (Michael Dudikoff) works at a prison for extremely dangerous juvenile offenders. Recruited to rescue a wealthy girl being held captive in Vietnam, he assembles a team composed of some of the most violent inmates, many of whom are enemies. After battling their way through the jungle, they lay siege to the fortress of the brutal warlord Vinh Moc (Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa), who has the hostage hidden away. shadesofblack.us.title: Sprung
shadesofblack.us.description: Clyde (Joe Torry) and his photographer pal Montel (Rusty Cundieff) meet gold digger Adina (Paula Jai Parker) and her friend Brandy (Tisha Campbell), a law student, at a party. While Clyde convinces Adina that he's wealthy, Montel and Brandy pair off and get along well. tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E15 Property Brothers - Amanda & Tre Tre and Amanda have been living in a rental for nearly three years, and as the kids get bigger their temporary home is getting smaller. They're ready to find a place of their own and are determined to stay in their exclusive lakefront community.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E17 Property Brothers - Rave & Michelle Along with their two little ones, Rave and Michelle are staying with his parents while hunting for the perfect suburban home. And though they're a close-knit family, living under one roof is proving too close for comfort.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E05 Farm to Table Andrea and David are foodies, but hosting in their "builder basic" yard is no fun. Brian and Sarah make their farm-to-table dreams come true, with a veggie garden, dining room, BBQ zone, and a play space for their 2 kids.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E07 Mom's Retreat Melissa and Lee's 3 boys need more room for sports, and Mom needs more peace and quiet! So Brian and Sarah turn the underused backyard into a sports court, a new lounge space, and a luxurious, 3-season Mom's retreat.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E10 Greenhouse Bliss Lynna is a single mom with three teenage kids and the time has come for her to have the back garden of her dreams. Brian and Sarah deliver in spades, with a 3 season hang-out, lush new landscaping, and a beautiful greenhouse.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E11 Multipurpose Cabana Brian and Sarah build a sun deck, outdoor dining area and a Grecian inspired, 3-season garage conversion.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E12 Communal Gathering Space H and her tenant Emma are bursting out of their 3-unit home. To help out both landlord and tenants, Brian and Sarah add storage space, plus a common lounge space in the backyard, with some urban inspired design touches.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E14 Modern Woodshop Newlyweds Cheryl and Gavin love their new home, but Cheryl doesn't love the sound of Gavin's woodworking in the garage. Brian and Sarah help by building a dedicated wood shop and some chic new living space in their urban backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E02 Family of Five Funhouse Love is large, but space is tight for Lara & Mike and their 5 children. Brian and Sarah free up space by building an activity-packed tree house and recreation court for the children, with grilling, dining and lounging areas for the whole family.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E04 Stained Glass Studio Couple Farzana & Reyan have maxed out all living space in their city-sized bungalow, leaving no room for Reyan's at-home stained-glass business or Farzana's writing. Brian and Sarah build Reyan a spacious studio and construct an inspiring deck area.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E05 Wellness Wonderland Breanna & Nick's life revolves around socializing and physical activity. Brian and Sarah convert an old, underused shed into a beautiful, zen'd out yoga studio and create backyard partying, lounging and dining areas.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E07 Plunge Pool Paradise Aarati & Dave both work from home, forcing their living room to be a triple duty working/living/children's play area. Brian and Sarah create a flexible structure, install a sleek and sophisticated plunge pool, and create an outdoor fireplace lounge.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E08 Pooch Party Pavillion Carly & Nate's social media star dog, Dean the Basset Hound, has a lot of four-legged friends visiting, leaving the home feeling cramped. Brian and Sarah make a bar/lounge for pet and owner gatherings, along with a stylish outdoor entertainment area.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E09 Social Central Sunroom Sonia & Paul are big social connectors in their community with a constant flow of visitors. Brian and Sarah turn their barren backyard into a social hotspot, complete with sunroom, giant chessboard, waterfall and stylish outdoor entertainment spaces.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E08 The Bushland Treehouse Paul and Trent want to escape their busy lives to a 600-acre conservation property.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E02 Forest Treehouse Delaval and Veronica are restoring 450 acres for conservation and funding it by building a treehouse in Swanton Novers Wood. A Scottish firm constructs it in 7 sections to minimize damage to the woodland habitat on delivery.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E03 Countryside Cabins Jamie Feilden's 60-acre farm doubles as a charity for urban youth. To fund it, he now plans two prefabricated elliptical cabins on a remote slope. They'll feature timber decks, open-plan living, and green roofs—though weather may delay the build.

tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E05 Scotland's Island Cottage Builder Justin and wife Emma tackle an ambitious modular home build on Scotland's remote North Uist.

tastemadehome.us.title: World's Most Secret Hotels
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E03 Hidden Escapes Explore some unique and unusual hotels in the USA, Finland, Canada and Scotland — from a hotel hidden within one of New York's busiest airport runways to a winter wonderland in the Arctic Circle.

tastemadehome.us.title: World's Most Secret Hotels
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E02 Remote Hideaways Explore some unique and unusual hotels in Jordan, England, Sweden, and Ecuador — from a desert resort that resembles a colony on Mars to a hotel in the clouds.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Three Amigos
tastemadetravel.us.description: On a mission to taste the world's best breakfast, the three big egos Gordon, Gino and Fred are venturing out of their comfort zones crossing over the USA border into Mexico. They hope to stay out of trouble as they drive their bad boy transporter. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - What Happens in Vegas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon wants to show Fred & Gino that the food and fresh produce are off the charts! In Las Vegas they indulge in one of the most expensive beef burgers. After a night at the casino they're on the road again to experience the real wild west. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - San Fran Summer of Love
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gino & Fred are excited to head to San Francisco for their very own Summer of Love. Gordon tries to embrace the flower power mood, but he's more interested in the 61 Michelin Stars. The boys travel to a Napa Valley vineyard in a hot air balloon. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Brokeback Mountain
tastemadetravel.us.description: After four weeks on the road, Gino's airing his feet in the back seat as the guys cruise along a Texan highway. Texas is a meat lover's paradise, and Gordon is keen to show the Europhiles some of the best BBQ known to man. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Italian Job
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred start their road trip in Gino's homeland of Italy, where Gino needs help to pull off an event that is close to his heart. Gino collects Gordon and Fred in a campervan to begin a road trip they won't be forgetting in a hurry. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The French Connection
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to France, where Fred has been asked to co-host an Oyster Festival in the beautiful Arcachon Bay, in just four days' time. Reunited with their campervan, Fred nominates himself as the driver in his homeland. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Highland Fling
tastemadetravel.us.description: The trio heads to Scotland as Gordon prepares to cook a feast for the chief of Clan Ramsay and his friends. Gordon shows the others how to dress like real Scotsmen as they go in search of Scottish beef, hunt for scallops and play some Highland Games. (Cooking, Travel) - 2025-09-05

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Mamma Mia! Off We Go Again
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to Greece to immerse themselves in the culinary traditions. The taste buddies go island-hopping, keen to learn more about the Mediterranean diet and how the country has one of the healthiest populations in the world. (Cooking, Travel)

truehistory.us.title: The World's Greatest Churches - The Church of the Holy Sepulchre
truehistory.us.description: Tracing the history of this church in the Holy Land; the medieval reconstruction seen today; the church's unusual structure, which incorporates the "aedicule"; individual chapels reflecting events of the passion of Christ. (Religious) - 2014-10-24

truehistory.us.title: The World's Greatest Churches - Hagia Sophia
truehistory.us.description: Learning about the past of this jewel of Constantinople; discovering an extraordinary architectural space; highlighting its dome and interiors; lingering over its mosaics, carved columns and decoration in colored marbles. (Religious) - 2014-10-24

truehistory.us.title: The World's Greatest Churches - The Cave Churches of Cappadocia
truehistory.us.description: Pondering the unusual churches of Turkish Cappadocia, elaborately carved into the sides of mountains; the lives of the monks and hermits who live there; studying the churches' frescoes that illustrate biblical scenes and the life of Jesus. (Religious) - 2014-10-24

truehistory.us.description: Uncovering the origins of the District of Columbia; how the location for the national government is chosen; the original design and vision for the city by artist and engineer Pierre Charles L'Enfant; the creation and history of the National Mall. (Travel) - 2019-03-29

sbsbrisbane.au.title: PBS Newshour
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Reviews and analysis of the day's news, presented by Amna Nawaz and Geoff Bennett for the Public Broadcasting Service (PBS) in the United States.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Going Places With Ernie Dingo - Bungle Bungles, Coranderrk, Cairns
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Ernie experiences the breathtaking Bungle Bungles in the heart of the Kimberley, Narelda visits Coranderrk with a Wurundjeri elder and Aaron steps into the studio with didge-legend Dave Hudson. (Entertainment)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: The Point - Yuendumu: Trust And Justice
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Explores the evolving relationship between the Yuendumu community and the Northern Territory police in the lead-up to Kumanjayi Walker's death, its immediate aftermath, and the community’s experience seven years on. Through the perspectives of Uncle Ned Jampijinpa Hargraves the episode considers the impact of these events and how they continue to shape the community today. (Current Affairs)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Nitv News: Nula - Nitv News: Nula 2026 Ep 43 ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
sbsbrisbane.au.description: The latest news from the oldest living culture, join Natalie Ahmat and the team of NITV journalists for stories from an Indigenous perspective. (News)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Plat Du Tour - Fondant Au Chocolat
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Guillaume visits a chocolatier in the town of Sallanches. He is put to work creating a local sweet specialty, while learning the secrets of fine chocolate. Guillaume makes a lush chocolate fondant to celebrate the importance of chocolate in the region. (Special Interest)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw - Great Australian Pub Meal, The
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Chef Jacqui Challinor and actor Dave Lawson join Adam to make great Australian pub meals at home. And they won't even charge you extra for sauce. (Entertainment)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: The Supervet - Monty Odin And Maya
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Toy poodle, Monty was showing huge promise in agility until his hip joint was damaged. Sheppard Dog, Odin has wobblers syndrome, a malformed vertebrae affecting his back legs. Noel proposes a unique solution for him. Malamute-husky cross, Maya was hit by a train and lost her foot. Suffering from hip dysplasia, Noel uses his technical skills along with a prosthetist. (Entertainment)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Jeopardy! - Jeopardy Series 42 Ep 180
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Ken Jennings hosts Jeopardy! Where the answers are revealed, and the contestants must guess the appropriate questions. (Entertainment)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Letters And Numbers - Letters And Numbers Series 5 Ep 91
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Two contestants pit their linguistic and numerical skills against each other and the clock in this entertaining quiz show. Join host Richard Morecroft along with maths whiz Lily Serna and wordsmith David Astle. (Entertainment)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Mastermind - Mastermind Series 5 Ep 80
sbsbrisbane.au.description: In this final round, the four reigning champions from this cycle battle it out to progress to the semi-finals. (Entertainment)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: SBS World News - Sbs World News 2026 Ep 324 ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Latest reports and analysis of major national and international news of the day from Australia's only world news service. (News)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Hotel Portofino - Alliances
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Period drama set on the Italian Riviera in the 'Roaring 20s', starring Natascha McElhone. As Cecil tries to buy his way back into Bella's affections, and Lucian and Constance acknowledge their mutual attraction, Nish aims to strike a blow against Mussolini's Fascists. (Entertainment)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Summer In The Isles Of Scilly - Episode 4
sbsbrisbane.au.description: On the Isles of Scilly, divers search a 17th-century shipwreck for clues to the past, while organisers prepare for a festival timed to a brief low tide linking two islands. Elsewhere, anticipation builds as a couple plans their wedding in the stunning archipelago, highlighting the unique events and community spirit that shape island life. (Documentary)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: A Royal Guide To Scotland - Royal Guide To Scotland, A
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Arguably the true home of the Royal Family, it's in Scotland that they let loose. From family BBQ's and weekend hikes at Balmoral, to university love affairs and ultimately the Queen's death - it's the location for many of their key moments. But it hasn't always been such a close relationship - go back to the 13th century and English monarchs weren't welcome north of the border. (Documentary)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: SBS World News Late - Sbs World News Late 2026 Ep 220 ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Latest reports and analysis of major national and international news of the day from Australia's only world news service. (News)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Helsinki Syndrome - Wednesday
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Jarmo Kiiski changes negotiating tactics, contacting Elias Karo personally for the first time, while On-scene Commander Hakkarainen completely cuts off Sanoma House, pushing the hostage taker into a corner. Cornered, Elias presses ahead with his original plan, ordering accomplice Lauri Ristiniemi to do all he can to help them succeed. Meanwhile, Hanna Raivio visits the national archive, searching for the final piece of evidence needed to publish the story. (Drama)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Darkness: Those Who Kill - Episode 5
sbsbrisbane.au.description: An unexpected witness statement from Kim's stepdaughter points the investigation firmly towards Robin Smith, leader of Kim's former gang. With Kim receiving threatening warnings to stay silent and violence erupting on the streets, Louise and Frederik must move quickly before the situation spirals beyond their control. (Drama)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Darkness: Those Who Kill - Episode 6
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Louise is convinced Robin's death is connected to a series of murders, but Frederik is reluctant to see it that way. Determined to prove her theory, Louise uncovers a chilling link between all the victims - one that points back to a tragic accident and a grieving family with reason enough for revenge. (Drama)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Wisting - Wisting Series 2 Ep 5
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Wisting and his team are alerted to a horrific crime scene in Larvik. The severed head of a young asylum seeker is displayed on a spike in the middle of the town square. FBI agent Maggie Griffin returns to investigate the case and aid Wisting. It is now of international interest. (Drama)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Wisting - Wisting Series 2 Ep 6
sbsbrisbane.au.description: When a body turns up in the net of a local fisherman, the two murders are linked. Will this lead the detectives to Layla's remains? After a conversation with her brother, Line suspects that Wisting has been intimate with the head of the care centre. (Drama)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Scotland's Scenic Railways - Strathspey Steam Railway
sbsbrisbane.au.description: The Cairngorms National Park was created in 2003 and is home to the UK’s highest mountain range. Cutting through the Cairngorms is the Highland Mainline railway. Running 118 miles through glorious countryside, the Highland Mainline links the towns and villages dotted along the line from Inverness to Perth. (Documentary)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Bamay - Tjoritja Ulpmara: Water In The Desert
sbsbrisbane.au.description: In the West MacDonnell Ranges, water defines survival. Waterholes, river channels and peaks like Mount Sonder emerge from arid land. This episode follows water through Country. (Documentary)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Destination Flavour Singapore Bitesize - Singapore Chilli Crab
sbsbrisbane.au.description: The best bits of Adam Liaw's travels in Singapore, as he explores its vibrant food scene. (Entertainment)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Nhk World English News Morning
sbsbrisbane.au.description: English news from Japan's Broadcasting Corporation, NHK, delivering the latest in business, technology, health, environmental and world news. (News)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Anc Philippines The World Tonight
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Multi-award winning newscast on ABS-CBN and ANC, The World Tonight delivers the top stories of the day, covering political, economic, and social sectors on both local and global fronts. (News)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Dw English News - Dw English News Morning
sbsbrisbane.au.description: News and analysis of the top international and European news and current affairs from Berlin, in English. (News)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Al Jazeera News
sbsbrisbane.au.description: News via satellite from Al Jazeera Satellite Network, Qatar, in English. (News)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: BBC News At Six
sbsbrisbane.au.description: The latest national and international news stories from the BBC News team from London, UK, in English. (News)

sbsbrisbane.au.description: International news and current affairs television from Paris, offering a French perspective on world events, in English. (News)

sbsbrisbane.au.description: All the best moments and bits from Destination Flavour China, led by famed chef and author Adam Liaw. (Documentary)

sbsbrisbane.au.description: Paul O'Grady helps a poodle overcome separation anxiety, he meets a plummer terrier with extreme guarding issues and he falls for a young, smelly bulldog with a bad case of cherry eye. (Documentary)

sbsbrisbane.au.description: Paul O'Grady helps a shar pei-cross who needs surgery to correct her sight problems, a destructive mastiff with an unusual palette, and a lonely bichon frise cross whose separation anxiety means he's not afraid to kick off. (Documentary)

sbsmelbourne.au.description: Toy poodle, Monty was showing huge promise in agility until his hip joint was damaged. sbsmelbourne.au.title: Summer In The Isles Of Scilly - Episode 4
sbsmelbourne.au.description: On the Isles of Scilly, divers search a 17th-century shipwreck for clues to the past, while organisers prepare for a festival timed to a brief low tide linking two islands. Elsewhere, anticipation builds as a couple plans their wedding in the stunning archipelago, highlighting the unique events and community spirit that shape island life. (Documentary)

sbsmelbourne.au.title: A Royal Guide To Scotland - Royal Guide To Scotland, A
sbsmelbourne.au.description: Arguably the true home of the Royal Family, it's in Scotland that they let loose. From family BBQ's and weekend hikes at Balmoral, to university love affairs and ultimately the Queen's death - it's the location for many of their key moments. But it hasn't always been such a close relationship - go back to the 13th century and English monarchs weren't welcome north of the border. (Documentary)

sbsmelbourne.au.title: Helsinki Syndrome - Wednesday
sbsmelbourne.au.description: Jarmo Kiiski changes negotiating tactics, contacting Elias Karo personally for the first time, while On-scene Commander Hakkarainen completely cuts off Sanoma House, pushing the hostage taker into a corner. Cornered, Elias presses ahead with his original plan, ordering accomplice Lauri Ristiniemi to do all he can to help them succeed. Meanwhile, Hanna Raivio visits the national archive, searching for the final piece of evidence needed to publish the story. (Drama)

sbsmelbourne.au.title: Darkness: Those Who Kill - Episode 5
sbsmelbourne.au.description: An unexpected witness statement from Kim's stepdaughter points the investigation firmly towards Robin Smith, leader of Kim's former gang. With Kim receiving threatening warnings to stay silent and violence erupting on the streets, Louise and Frederik must move quickly before the situation spirals beyond their control. (Drama)

sbsmelbourne.au.title: Darkness: Those Who Kill - Episode 6

sbsmelbourne.au.title: Wisting - Wisting Series 2 Ep 6

sbsmelbourne.au.title: Scotland's Scenic Railways - Strathspey Steam Railway
sbsmelbourne.au.description: The Cairngorms National Park was created in 2003 and is home to the UK’s highest mountain range. Cutting through the Cairngorms is the Highland Mainline railway. Running 118 miles through glorious countryside, the Highland Mainline links the towns and villages dotted along the line from Inverness to Perth. (Documentary)
